pages.title: Hyperlattice Frame
pages.text: A scaffold folded through a fourth dimension so that a nine-by-nine assembly has room for everything inside it. From any angle it looks slightly too small to hold what it holds. Its corners never quite meet where the eye expects.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Extreme Assembly Table kept running out of space. A tesseract core gave the frame a fourth dimension to fold into, and graviton crystals held the fold steady. The frame is bigger on the inside, in the honest geometric sense.
Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Hyperdimensional Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Transfinite Weave.
